title: Module of another type in a configured slot
summary: A slot holds a different module type than the project configures, so the CPU exchanges no data with it.

sections.heading: Recognize it
sections.body: The hardware comparison reports a type mismatch at one slot; every channel of that slot has bad quality and the inputs hold their substitute values. It typically appears after a module was replaced.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Compare the module's type label with the project's configuration for that slot. Fit the configured type, or change the project deliberately if the design changed, and download it.

modeled: Generic modular station: configured and detected modules compared per slot, module electronics supply and field supply as separate conditions, channel modes against the drawing, process image addresses, wiring from devices to terminals
approximated: Module status and LEDs follow generic PLC Lab rules, not a vendor's indicator behavior
A module of the wrong type or in an unconfigured slot exchanges no data and its inputs hold substitute value 0
omitted: Vendor-specific module parameters, diagnostic codes and firmware
Hot swapping and module start-up times

troubleshooting.effect: Every channel of the slot is invalid
symptoms: Module fault quality on all its channels
diagnosticMethod: Compare the detected station with the project
repair: Fit the configured module type, or correct the project deliberately
troubleshooting.explanation: The CPU only exchanges data with a module whose type matches the configuration of its slot.
